argv: Make a cinematic luxury Black Rose train campaign with a male model, the Skyy mascot, dramatic lighting and a big reveal.
stdout:
{
  "mode": "lifestyle_scene",
  "prompts": [
    {
      "prompt": "[SCENE]
Grand European train station at midnight — vaulted iron-and-glass ceiling, billowing steam catching shafts of light from overhead arc lamps, polished black marble floors reflecting amber and cobalt. A luxury overnight express idles at the platform, its lacquered black carriages trimmed in brushed gold. The atmosphere is operatic, theatrical, charged with anticipation — a Black Rose campaign reveal moment frozen at the threshold between departure and arrival.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
A single oversized black rose — deep obsidian petals edged with a faint bioluminescent violet — held at chest height by the male model's gloved right hand, positioned center-left of frame. The rose is the chromatic anchor: every other element in the scene orbits its darkness. A secondary cluster of black roses spills from a leather-strapped trunk on the platform behind him, petals catching the arc lamp at 5500K daylight neutral.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
Male model, mid-30s, sharp angular features, dressed in a floor-length black wool overcoat with wide lapels and a single gold pin. He stands at the open carriage door, one foot on the iron step, body turned three-quarters toward camera in a controlled pivot — not looking at the lens but past it, as if acknowledging an audience just offscreen. His posture is commanding and still. Beside him at knee height, the Skyy mascot — a sleek, stylized cobalt-blue figure with luminous white eyes — perches on the carriage step railing, one hand braced against the doorframe, gaze directed upward at the model in reverent complicity. The mascot is rendered with the same photographic realism as the environment: tactile surface, cast shadow, ambient reflection on the black carriage door.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Cast-iron platform clock reading 00:01 overhead. A red-capped porter frozen mid-step in soft background blur. Gold lettering on the carriage door reads "VOITURE NOIRE." Scattered rose petals on the marble platform floor, each casting a micro contact shadow. A leather Gladstone bag monogrammed in gold rests against the model's left leg. Steam curls upward from beneath the carriage, catching the gridded spot from above and fragmenting into volumetric light columns.

[LIGHTING]
Primary: Rembrandt 45° camera-right, hard direct strobe at 5500K daylight neutral, carving deep shadow on the model's left cheek and coat lapel — sharp-edged shadow on the carriage door behind him. Secondary: three-quarter back rim at 45° camera-left, gridded spot at 3200K tungsten, outlining the model's shoulder and the Skyy mascot's cobalt surface in warm gold separation light. Fill: motivated practical light from the platform arc lamps above, ambient at 4200K, providing soft bounced fill from the polished marble floor below — gentle wraparound preventing the scene from collapsing into pure silhouette. Steam columns lit by a gobo-shaped beam from directly above, isolating the volumetric atmosphere at 5000K. Shadow behavior: deep shadow side with selective fill on the model's face; contact shadow only at base of the rose stem and mascot feet; soft falloff with gradient transition across the marble floor.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 50mm standard, aperture f/2.8, shallow-to-mid depth of field — tack focus on the black rose petals and the model's gloved hand, the mascot rendered in sharp resolution, the porter and clock softening into painterly bokeh behind. Camera angle: low three-quarter, lens at mid-chest height, shooting slightly upward — conferring scale and authority on both model and mascot.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Operatic, cinematic, indulgent. The air is dense with steam and anticipation — the feeling of a curtain rising. Midnight luxury. A campaign reveal that feels like the opening frame of a film rather than an advertisement. Tension between stillness and imminent motion.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Obsidian black and deep charcoal as dominant tones. Cobalt blue (mascot) as the brand accent — saturated but not neon, photographic. Burnished gold as trim and highlight. Faint violet iridescence on rose petal edges as the supernatural signature. Contrast: high — near-black shadows with controlled specular highlights. No crushed blacks; shadow detail preserved in coat texture and marble reflection.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Gregory Crewdson, Erwin Olaf, and Nadav Kander. Editorial commercial photography — cinematic tableau with the compositional deliberateness of a directed film still. Large-format luxury campaign aesthetic.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic fabric and leather textures, natural hand and glove detail, photographic mascot integration with full cast shadow and surface reflection, volumetric steam with visible light scattering, polished marble floor reflections accurate to scene lighting, gold lettering with micro-specular catch light.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no asymmetric eyes,
no extra teeth, no melted facial features, no warped fingers or hands,
no plastic skin, no orange-tan skin, no over-smoothed retouching,
no doll eyes, no misaligned facial features, no rubber-like skin texture,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no mascot rendered as flat cartoon overlay, no tonal inconsistency between mascot and environment.
